messages.text: Is it quiet enough to run in my office?

**Yes — it's desk/office friendly.**

- **~40–45 dB** at full load (quiet-room level — think a gentle fan, not a server rack)
- **0.5 kg, ~20 × 11 × 5.8 cm** — palm-sized, sits on its included 3D-printed stand
- One large front fan moving air slowly across an adequate heatsink = quiet by design, not a screaming small blower
- ASIC temps hold ~57 °C at full 6 TH/s, so it's not fighting to stay cool

No published mic distance, so "silent" would be a stretch — but **most owners run these on a desk without a second thought.**
